Primary treatment consists of 2-millimeter (mm) drum screens with a bypass channel/bar with screens and a vortex grit removal mechanism.
Each bioreactor train consists of two anoxic zones followed by one aerobic zone with two aeration grids.
Each bioreactor train consists of two anoxic zones followed by one aerobic zone with two aeration grids.
Flow from the aerobic zone is pumped to the membrane filtration units, which provide tertiary treatment.
The tertiary-treated effluent is disinfected using an ultraviolet light (UV) disinfection system.
Currently, disinfected tertiary-treated wastewater is stored in one 3.08 million gallon (MG) bolted-steel tank.
A second 3.08 MG bolted-steel tank will be added with the completion of Phase II, as described in section II.E of this Fact Sheet.
